list.name: ds_cm
list.label: SCCM Database
list.description: Microsoft SQL Server data source for the Configuration Manager site database (CM_<site code>), with a read-only login. Chosen automatically if its name contains "SCCM", "ConfigMgr" or "Configuration Manager"; otherwise pick it here.

title: SCCM - Deployments

panels.description: Application, program, script and task sequence deployments (not software updates).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS [Deployments],
  ISNULL(SUM(NumberTotal), 0) AS [Assignments],
  ISNULL(SUM(NumberSuccess), 0) AS [Succeeded],
  ISNULL(SUM(NumberInProgress), 0) AS [In progress],
  ISNULL(SUM(NumberErrors), 0) AS [Failed],
  SUM(CASE WHEN NumberErrors > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Deployments with errors]
FROM dbo.v_DeploymentSummary
WHERE FeatureType <> 5

panels.title: Assignments

panels.description: Applications, programs, scripts and task sequences with their results. Software updates are on the Software Updates dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 300
  d.SoftwareName AS [Software],
  CASE d.FeatureType WHEN 1 THEN 'Application' WHEN 2 THEN 'Program' WHEN 3 THEN 'Mobile program' WHEN 4 THEN 'Script' WHEN 6 THEN 'Baseline' WHEN 7 THEN 'Task sequence'
       WHEN 8 THEN 'Content distribution' WHEN 11 THEN 'Configuration policy' ELSE 'Other' END AS [Type],
  d.CollectionName AS [Collection],
  CASE d.DeploymentIntent WHEN 1 THEN 'Required' WHEN 2 THEN 'Available' WHEN 3 THEN 'Simulate' ELSE 'Other' END AS [Purpose],
  d.DeploymentTime AS [Available from],
  d.EnforcementDeadline AS [Deadline],
  d.NumberTotal AS [Targeted],
  d.NumberSuccess AS [Succeeded],
  d.NumberInProgress AS [In progress],
  d.NumberErrors AS [Failed],
  d.NumberUnknown AS [Unknown],
  CASE WHEN d.NumberTotal > 0 THEN CAST(100.0 * d.NumberSuccess / d.NumberTotal AS decimal(5, 1)) END AS [Success %]
FROM dbo.v_DeploymentSummary d
WHERE d.FeatureType <> 5
ORDER BY d.NumberErrors DESC, d.DeploymentTime DESC

panels.title: Deployments (most errors first)

panels.description: Task sequence steps that ended with a non-zero exit code.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 100
  t.ExecutionTime AS [Time],
  ISNULL(s.Name0, CAST(t.ResourceID AS varchar(20))) AS [Device],
  t.AdvertisementID AS [Deployment ID],
  t.GroupName AS [Group],
  t.ActionName AS [Step],
  t.ExitCode AS [Exit code],
  LEFT(t.ActionOutput, 200) AS [Output]
FROM dbo.v_TaskExecutionStatus t
LEFT JOIN dbo.v_R_System s ON s.ResourceID = t.ResourceID
WHERE t.ExitCode <> 0
ORDER BY t.ExecutionTime DESC
